literal_meaning: মানুষের মুখে উচ্চারণীয় বা মানুষের যোগ্য শব্দ
figurative_meaning_en: Worthy of being called a human or acceptable as a true human
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমাজের মানুষদের মধ্যে তিনি ছিলেন একমাত্র মনুষ্যপদবাচ্য।
এই যুগের নেতাদের মধ্যে কেউই মনুষ্যপদবাচ্য নন।
example_sentences_in_english: Among the people of society, he was the only one worthy of being called a true human.
None of the leaders of this era are worthy of being called true humans.
history: According to Rabindranath Tagore, among contemporary Bengalis, only Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar was considered মনুষ্যপদবাচ্য, highlighting his exemplary humanity.
note: This term is notably used in Rabindranath Tagore's writings to praise Vidyasagar's character.
